scientific_integrity: Uses an explicitly cited general graph theorem and a complete family-specific combinatorial proof; independently structured finite-state scripts check the resulting labelled counts. All reported computations have captured outputs; no claim of external certification.
scientific_limitations: Only the deterministic synchronous three-color threshold-one Greenberg–Hastings rule on the complement of a perfect matching with at least four matched pairs. The general graph circulation criterion is prior work. The result does not classify the first-entry-time distribution; finite computations only check small instances. Historical priority is provisional and no independent audit has been performed.
title: Exact extinction basins and recurrent populations for three-state excitation on cocktail-party graphs
